metadata.scope: exact Gaussian/angular Fourier reduction plus finite validation; no directional asymptotic theorem

exact_harmonic_reduction.H_definition: H_l(p)=prod_{q^e||p, q=1 mod 4} D_e(8 l alpha_q), D_e(x)=sum_{k=-e}^e exp(i k x); H_0=G by continuity
exact_harmonic_reduction.kernel_region_1: 0<t<1/sqrt(2): k0=8 asin(t)/pi-1, a_l=4 sin(4 l asin(t))/(pi l)
exact_harmonic_reduction.kernel_region_2: 1/sqrt(2)<t<1: k0=4 acos(t)/pi, a_l=2 sin(4 l acos(t))/(pi l)
exact_harmonic_reduction.mobius_fourier_gap: D(B)=sum_shell 1/(G(p)-1) sum_{m|gcd(p,z)} mu(m) [(G(p/m)-1) k0(t) + sum_{l>=1} a_l(t)(H_l(p/m)-1)], interpreted by Fejer limits away from strict-order boundaries
exact_harmonic_reduction.zero_mode_bridge: H_0=G, so the frozen Stage12 scalar representation count is the zero angular mode; Stage13 directional information begins in l>=1.

multiplicative_structure.split_prime_power: H_l(q^e)=D_e(8 l alpha_q)=sin(4 l (2e+1) alpha_q)/sin(4 l alpha_q), with the continuous limiting value when the denominator vanishes
multiplicative_structure.split_local_generating_function: sum_{e>=0} H_l(q^e) X^e=(1+X)/(1-2 cos(8 l alpha_q) X+X^2)
multiplicative_structure.nonsplit_local_generating_function: for q=2 or q=3 mod 4, H_l(q^e)=1 and sum_{e>=0} H_l(q^e)X^e=1/(1-X)
multiplicative_structure.dirichlet_euler_product: sum_n H_l(n)n^{-s}=prod_{q=1 mod 4}(1+q^{-s})/(1-2 cos(8 l alpha_q)q^{-s}+q^{-2s}) * prod_{q=2 or 3 mod 4}(1-q^{-s})^{-1}, Re(s)>1
multiplicative_structure.primitive_local_transform: For multiplicative F, T_F(p,g)=sum_{m|g}mu(m)(F(p/m)-1)=prod_{q^e||p,q not|g}F(q^e)*prod_{q^e||p,q|g}(F(q^e)-F(q^{e-1})) - 1_{g=1}. For F=G the split-prime difference is 2; for F=H_l it is 2 cos(8 l e alpha_q). If g contains q=3 mod 4, every such transform vanishes.
multiplicative_structure.collapsed_shell_gap: d_{p,z}=[k0(t) T_G(p,g)+sum_{l>=1}a_l(t)T_{H_l}(p,g)]/(G(p)-1), g=gcd(p,z), again interpreted by Fejer limits away from boundaries.
multiplicative_structure.remaining_obstruction: the outer G-neutral factor 1/(G(p)-1) and the joint distribution of outer-shell t with the gcd support g remain nonmultiplicative even though H_l and the primitive Mobius numerator are prime-local.

conclusion.interpretation: The large bc-heavy inner angular discrepancy is not a featureless angular error: at B=100000 its first cos(4 theta) mode accounts for most of the discrepancy, especially in EE. The scalar Stage12 G function is exactly the zero mode of the same multiplicative Gaussian family H_l.
conclusion.not_proved: No asymptotic estimate for H_l shell averages, no bound making l=1 asymptotically dominant, and no limiting directional ratio is proved.
conclusion.next: Stage13-7f: analyze the l=1 H_1 shell average together with the odd-divisor primitive coupling; compare its Euler product with classical Gaussian angular/Hecke L-function machinery before claiming an asymptotic.
